blocks.input_text:
[請求項1]
厚み方向に貫通する開口部（１０１）を形成する枠体（１００Ａ，１００Ｂ，１００Ｃ，１００Ｄ，１００Ｅ，１００Ｆ，１００Ｇ，１００Ｈ）を備え、
前記枠体（１００Ａ，１００Ｂ，１００Ｃ，１００Ｄ，１００Ｅ，１００Ｆ，１００Ｇ，１００Ｈ）は、
前記開口部（１０１）を挿通する第１ベルト（９１）が掛け回される第１掛部（１０，１０Ｂ，１０Ｇ，１０Ｈ，２０１）と、
前記厚み方向に直交する連結方向において前記第１掛部（１０，１０Ｂ，１０Ｇ，１０Ｈ，２０１）との間に前記開口部（１０１）を挟んで配置され、前記開口部（１０１）を挿通する第２ベルト（９２）が掛け回される第２掛部（２０，２０Ｃ，３０１）と、
前記厚み方向および前記連結方向に直交する幅方向において互いの間に前記開口部（１０１）を挟んで配置される第１側部（３０Ａ）および第２側部（３０Ｂ）と、
前記第１側部（３０Ａ）および前記第２側部（３０Ｂ）の少なくとも一方に接続され、前記第１掛部（１０，１０Ｂ，１０Ｇ，１０Ｈ，２０１）を支持する支持部（４０，４０Ｅ，４０Ｆ，４０Ｇ，４０Ｈ）と、を備え、
前記支持部（４０，４０Ｅ，４０Ｆ，４０Ｇ，４０Ｈ）の少なくとも一部は、前記第１掛部（１０，１０Ｂ，１０Ｇ，１０Ｈ，２０１）が前記第１ベルト（９１）から荷重を受けることにより弾性変形し、前記第１掛部（１０，１０Ｂ，１０Ｇ，１０Ｈ，２０１）を前記第２掛部（２０，２０Ｃ，３０１）から離間する方向に変位させる、ベルト連結具。
blocks.output_text:
1. A belt connecting device comprising a frame body (100A, 100B, 100C, 100D, 100E, 100F, 100G, 100H) having an opening (101) formed therethrough in a thickness direction,
wherein the frame body (100A, 100B, 100C, 100D, 100E, 100F, 100G, 100H) includes:
a first hanging portion (10, 10B, 10G, 10H, 201) around which a first belt (91) passing through the opening (101) is wound;
a second hanging portion (20, 20C, 301) disposed across the opening (101) from the first hanging portion (10, 10B, 10G, 10H, 201) in a connecting direction orthogonal to the thickness direction, and around which a second belt (92) passing through the opening (101) is wound;
a first side portion (30A) and a second side portion (30B) disposed across the opening (101) from each other in a width direction orthogonal to both the thickness direction and the connecting direction; and
a support portion (40, 40E, 40F, 40G, 40H) connected to at least one of the first side portion (30A) and the second side portion (30B) and supporting the first hanging portion (10, 10B, 10G, 10H, 201),
wherein at least a part of the support portion (40, 40E, 40F, 40G, 40H) elastically deforms when the first hanging portion (10, 10B, 10G, 10H, 201) receives a load from the first belt (91), thereby displacing the first hanging portion (10, 10B, 10G, 10H, 201) in a direction away from the second hanging portion (20, 20C, 301).
